title: 5 Stradbrook Road, Blackrock, Co. Dublin, A94T2R4
seoTitle: 5 Stradbrook Road, Blackrock, Co. Dublin, A94T2R4
description:
Janet Carroll Estate Agents are delighted to present 5 Stradbrook Road to the market for sale by Private Treaty.

Exceptional quality, exquisite style and thoughtfully curated throughout, describe the interiors of this entire property. Extending to approximately 173.1ms /1,863 sq.ft, plus a separately detached accommodation of 50ms / 538 sq ft, collectively offers the new owners, a luxurious and versatile home.

It has been renovated by its current owners to the highest standards. The result is a home that combines timeless elegance with warmth and sophistication — with every detail thoughtfully considered to create bright, generously proportioned interiors. Striking the perfect balance of style, comfort and tranquillity, it offers an atmosphere that is both welcoming and effortlessly elegant.

Its impressive separately detached accommodation, which has bespoke exterior cladding measures c.50 ms/ 538sq.ft and offers a large open plan room, a separate large room with ensuite, delivering incredible versatility which could be used as a luxurious home office, studio, gym, guest accommodation, or a tranquil escape from the main residence. 
It also presents a superb opportunity to generate additional income, with potential rental earnings of up to €14,000 per annum, tax-free under the current Rent-a-Room Relief Scheme and has its own independent entrance/exit to the side of the house.

Of particular interest is the glorious rear garden, designed by Ireland’s most prolific celebrity Designer Gardener, Diarmuid Gavin featuring a large, raised timber deck off the main kitchen overlooking this exquisite garden. The deck is covered with an automated awning and matching side awning- wind breaker- to provide the outdoor-indoor feel for entertaining friends and family under cover.
Masterfully landscaped, with mature trees from Silver Birches to Japanese Maples, the garden is beautifully designed for low-maintenance enjoyment, offering a ‘catwalk’ footpath in the logo of COCO Channel, laid out in Mosaic tiles flown in from Belgium. In mirroring the interior’s sunken lounge, Diarmuid Gavin created a mini sunken lounge to capture the afternoon and evening sun providing the perfect spot for al fresco dining.

To the front, you’ll find generous off-street parking and a tastefully landscaped garden, creating an immediate sense of arrival. With a convenient pedestrian entrance to the rear with two garden sheds for storage and a vehicular entrance to the front, this home is finished to an exceptional high standard in every respect.

No. 5 is ideally positioned on Stradbrook Road, close to all that Blackrock and Monkstown have to offer, including a wide range of shops, cafés, pubs and restaurants. The nearby coast also provides beautiful seafront walks. The area is home to several highly regarded schools, including Blackrock College, Willow Park, St Andrew’s College, Loretto College, St. Raphaela Secondary, Rathdown School,  CBC Monkstown, Scoil Lorcain, Carysfort National School, Rockford Manor (to name but a few). The IADT College, Dun Laoghaire Institute of Art and Design and UCD Michael Smurfit Graduate Business School are within walking distance. Easy access to Dublin is provided by nearby transport links including multiple Dublin bus routes and the DART, making the city centre and beyond readily reachable.

A truly special family home—crafted with style and flair to offer beautifully presented, bright rooms, peace and tranquillity, and a way of living that you’ll be proud to call your own.
